## 2026-11-15：S2 受控浏览器／像素评估器 v1 校准

本步完成隔离截图、像素／SSIM、关键计算样式与差异图基础设施，**不等于S2全部生产接入、真实迁移组件验收或新30项通过**。沿用报告技能区分自动校准与人工确认；旧129单元及元数据保留。旧视觉主路径和0字节占位工具不变，新增显式入口，详见 `docs/ir-design/controlled-browser-pixel-v1.md` 与 `data/experiments/analysis/controlled_browser_pixel_v1_20261115/REPORT.md`。

- 真实隔离Edge两次成功启动，各9页／7比较／9项预期控制；8个非持续变化页面跨启动截图SHA与关键样式相同。原生Vue2.7.16／San3.15.6仅为小样例，非Trip或TaskManager完整界面。
- 相同HTML及原生框架小样例像素差0；颜色变化42483/307200像素（SSIM0.999928）、padding变化4139/307200像素（SSIM0.969511）均拒绝。**不能把1-SSIM当不同像素比例，也不能只凭SSIM接近1放行颜色差异。**
- 报错、CSP网络拒绝、不稳定页面即使与自身第一帧比较得同图，仍阻断；因此成功校准result的顶层blocked/false是负向控制预期，不能改成全通过。另5项未就绪／缺元素／溢出／缺浏览器／覆盖旧目录的失败路径均正确拒绝。
- 新27项、旧评估校准17项、通知异常审计15项，共59项分别执行通过；不是全仓库或旧273项campaign。53个既有相关文件、3个人工配置及源／候选指纹不变。无模型、无新人工确认、无规则／Prompt更改、无commit/push；原24/30、6失败、1,821,544 tokens不回填。
- 首轮浏览器连接断开及临时目录清理失败、首次测试因仍指向失败run而setup失败均保留；隔离重试与显式更正证据路径后成功，没有抹去失败。仅清理了首轮自己创建且无进程使用的临时profile，失败证据保留。

视口640×480、DPR1、浅色、固定时间／随机数、语言／时区及默认Arial，明确ready和重复截图；SSIM定义为11×11高斯sigma1.5、valid区域的灰度总体矩，独立二维参考校验。21项关键样式及矩形另比。阈值只是严格校准值，尚非生产阈值；浏览器与字体仅记录指纹、未vendoring，未逐字形证明字体解析；只支持可信自包含HTML及受限视口，不是恶意代码沙箱或完整交互证明。

下一项仍是S2真实冻结产物完整页面适配和分层开发样例校准，然后再冻结生产阈值／反馈协议及接入批处理。任意公开键、通知与异常阶段未决边界继续保留，不以小样例解除阻断。下格只读复核本轮证据，不重跑浏览器或模型；未打开Notebook UI。

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re
root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p / 'migration_pipeline').is_dir() and (p / 'notebooks').is_dir())
base = root / 'data/experiments/analysis/controlled_browser_pixel_v1_20261115'
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for line in (base / 'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
    expected, relative = line.split('  ', 1)
    path = (base / relative).resolve()
    assert path.is_relative_to(base.resolve()) and sha(path) == expected, relative
baseline = read(base / 'baseline.json')
for path, expected in {**baseline['protected'], **baseline['manual']}.items():
    assert sha(root / path) == expected, path
assert len(baseline['protected']) == 53 and len(baseline['manual']) == 3
for field in ['source','candidate']:
    assert sha(root / baseline[field]['path']) == baseline[field]['sha256']
prior_seal = root / baseline['prior_seal']['path']
assert sha(prior_seal) == baseline['prior_seal']['sha256']
for line in prior_seal.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
    expected, relative = line.split('  ', 1)
    assert sha(prior_seal.parent / relative) == expected
audit = read(base / 'audit.json')
assert audit['status'] == 'calibration_passed_production_integration_pending'
assert audit['dynamic_public_key_block_retained'] and audit['model_calls'] == 0
assert not audit['production_integration_enabled'] and not audit['component_acceptance_added']
assert not audit['production_thresholds_selected'] and not audit['notification_or_exception_boundary_resolved']
assert audit['original_batch'] == {'configured':30,'passed':24,'failed':6,'execution_errors':0,'total_tokens':1821544}
runs = []
for folder in ['run2','repeat']:
    result = read(base / folder / 'result.json')
    summary = read(base / folder / 'calibration.json')
    assert summary['calibrationPassed'] and len(summary['checks']) == 9 and all(summary['checks'].values())
    assert result['status'] == 'blocked' and not result['passed']  # expected negative controls
    assert len(result['captures']) == 9 and len(result['comparisons']) == 7
    assert sha(base / folder / 'input.json') == summary['inputSha256']
    assert sha(base / folder / 'result.json') == summary['resultSha256']
    assert [p['passed'] for p in result['comparisons']] == [True,False,False,True,False,False,False]
    assert [p['eligible'] for p in result['comparisons']] == [True,True,True,True,False,False,False]
    assert result['comparisons'][1]['metrics']['changedPixels'] == 42483
    assert result['comparisons'][2]['metrics']['changedPixels'] == 4139
    for name, cap in result['captures'].items():
        assert sha(base / folder / (name+'.png')) == cap['screenshotSha256']
        assert sha(base / folder / (name+'-repeat.png')) == cap['repeatScreenshotSha256']
    runs.append(result)
assert runs[0]['browser'] == runs[1]['browser']
for name, cap in runs[0]['captures'].items():
    if name != 'unstable':
        assert cap['screenshotSha256'] == runs[1]['captures'][name]['screenshotSha256']
        assert cap['styles'] == runs[1]['captures'][name]['styles']
failures = read(base / 'failure_modes/failure_modes.json')
assert failures['allPassed'] and len(failures['checks']) == 5
assert all(row['checkPassed'] and row['exitCode'] == 2 for row in failures['checks'].values())
assert read(base / 'run/result.json')['status'] == 'blocked'
tests = read(base / 'tests.json')
assert tests['tests_run'] == 59 and tests['exit_code'] == 0 and not tests['prior_273_rerun']
assert sorted(row['tests_run'] for row in tests['rows']) == [15,17,27]
assert all(row['exit_code'] == 0 and re.search(r'\nOK\s*$',row['output']) for row in tests['rows'])
implementation = read(base / 'implementation.json')
assert len(implementation['files']) == 5
for path, item in implementation['files'].items():
    assert sha(root / path) == item['sha256']
    assert (root / path).read_text(encoding='utf-8') == item['frozen_source']
assert (root / 'migration_pipeline/utils/screenshot.py').stat().st_size == 0
assert (root / 'migration_pipeline/utils/image_diff.py').stat().st_size == 0
nb = read(root / baseline['notebook']['path'])
stable = lambda v: hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert stable(nb['cells'][:129]) == baseline['notebook']['cells_sha256']
assert stable(nb['metadata']) == baseline['notebook']['metadata_sha256']
print({'calibration_controls_per_run':9,'repeat_static_pages':8,'fail_closed_controls':5,'targeted_tests':59,'production_integrated':False,'model_calls':0,'batch':'unchanged 24/30'})
